normalize_screen_coordinates: normalize screen coordinates from pixel space to normalized camera frame coordinates preserving aspect ratio
image_coordinates: convert normalized camera frame coordinates back to pixel image coordinates for rendering
world_to_camera: transform 3D world coordinates into camera space using a rotation quaternion and translation vector
camera_to_world: transform 3D camera space coordinates back into world coordinates using a rotation quaternion and translation vector
review_camera_transforms: review the camera module functions for coordinate normalization and world-to-camera transformations
